title: WeaponsConfig
description: The weapon profiles, content/weapons.yaml (CONFIG-AND-CONTENT §7.2). NX-367 shipped id and targets (Q-CFG-10); NX-124 adds the combat numbers and bands (COMBAT §5.2). The loader checks bands: non-empty iff targets has AIR.

schema_version.description: File format version, unitless; the loader accepts only 1 (§4.4).

targets.description: What the weapon may fire on (COMBAT §5.1, CB-1, CB-10); no duplicates (loader). STRUCTURE = node defenses and bridges. SEA arrives with naval units (P3).

bands.description: Altitude reach against AIR targets, no duplicates (loader); [] when the weapon cannot fire on AIR (COMBAT §5.3).

range_m.description: Maximum range, unit m; no fire beyond it, and the range factor is 1.0 up to combat.range.full_pk_frac of it (COMBAT §5.2).

projectile_speed_mps.description: Unit m/s of world time; null = a gun, which lands on the fire tick. Impact delay = ceil(distance / speed / WORLD_DT) ticks (COMBAT CB-2, Q-GP-7).

base_pk.description: Hit probability before the track, range, evasion and masking factors, unit probability, 0 to 1 (COMBAT CB-4).

damage.description: Hit points removed by a hit before armor, unit hp (COMBAT CB-5).

reload_s.description: Unit s of world time between this weapon's shots (CFG-9).

ammo.description: Rounds in a full load, unit rounds; guns included (Q-CBT-7).
